verdict_reason: Logic, MDC null/blank handling, header-name consistency with RequestTracingFilter and unit tests are all sound, but the interceptor is no longer registered anywhere after RestClientConfig was deleted in this PR, so it is dead code.

todos.issue: Interceptor is never registered: this PR deletes RestClientConfig (the only place that wired it via RestClient.Builder.requestInterceptor / RestTemplateBuilder.interceptors), and Spring Boot does not auto-apply ClientHttpRequestInterceptor beans to the auto-configured builders, so the @Component is instantiated but never runs and the Javadoc claim that it adds the header to 'every outbound HTTP call made via RestClient or RestTemplate' is now false
todos.fix: Either delete the interceptor and its test until an outbound HTTP client exists, or add a RestClientCustomizer/RestTemplateCustomizer @Bean that registers it (and correct the Javadoc to say the header name is configurable via cdp.tracing.header-name)
